versions.subject: Rule: PowerShell script run in AppData folders
versions.detection:
condition: selection
selection:
    EventID: 1
    CommandLine: 
        - '* /c powershell*\AppData\Local\*'
        - '* /c powershell*\AppData\Roaming\*'
selection:
    EventID: 4688
    ProcessCommandLine: 
        - '* /c powershell*\AppData\Local\*'
        - '* /c powershell*\AppData\Roaming\*'

versions.subject: fix: condition in PS AppData rule
versions.detection:
selection1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'powershell.exe'
        - '\powershell'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/c '
        - '\AppData\'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Local\'
        - 'Roaming\'
condition: selection1 and selection2
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*powershell.exe*", "*\\powershell*") CommandLine="*/c *" CommandLine="*\\AppData\\*" CommandLine IN ("*Local\\*", "*Roaming\\*")
